  "sql": "SELECT c.name, avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.delivered_at - sh.shipped_at)) / 86400.0) AS avg_delivery_days FROM shipments sh JOIN couriers c ON c.id = sh.courier_id WHERE sh.status = 'delivered' AND sh.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND sh.delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC LIMIT 100",
